description: Deployments on the brand's Vercel account, newest first: URL, state (READY, BUILDING, QUEUED, ERROR, CANCELED...), target (production or preview), when it was created and became ready, the commit message and Vercel's inspector link. Filter by projectId, target or state, or pass deploymentId (an id or a deployment URL) to read one, e.g. to see whether a page you just deployed is READY. Read-only, free. Needs Vercel connected (Settings > Connectors > Vercel, or connect_connector with an access token).

deploymentId.description: read ONE deployment by id or URL

state.description: filter to deployments in this state

target.description: filter by environment: production, preview or staging

until.description: the nextCursor a previous page returned — the next (older) page

name: list_vercel_deployments
title: List Vercel deployments
